item.title: Serendipity Moments: 1% Deity Encounters
item.description: 1% chance deity encounters. No grinding. Pure randomness. When it happens, you're face-to-face with a deity who exists only for you for 60 seconds. Rarity creates value.

item.title: Archaeological Fossils: Your Actions Become History
item.description: Your ritual fossilizes after 7 days. 30 days later, other players excavate it. Your gameplay becomes their discovery. Asynchronous multiplayer through archaeological time.

item.title: Ritual Replay: 6-Second Video Essence Capture
item.description: The game automatically captures your ritual's peak 6 seconds. No recording apps. No editing. Just the essence. Share it or keep it private. Your choice.

item.title: Sunrise/Sunset Awareness: Real-Time Solar Rewards
item.description: The game knows when the sun rises in YOUR location. Catch dawn or dusk rituals for 2× XP and solar blessings. Seasonal adjustments reward winter early risers with 3× XP.

item.title: Mobile-First Design: No PC Port (Ever)
item.description: This game will never come to PC. Mobile-first, mobile-only, forever. GPS, accelerometer, always-with-you design. Constraint breeds creativity. We're doubling down on mobile excellence.
